fair_value_reason: The agents' fair values are 89.5, 90, 85.5, 88.6 and 89.5 (mean 88.6). All share 2.578B post-split diluted shares, 2027 EPS of $3.25-3.29, 12-13% growth into 2028, and a 24-24.5x multiple. I use NTM EPS of about $3.67 x 24.25x = $89. agent_3's extra discount for the 2028 capex cliff and Kyber is partly offset by the verified Edgewater evidence (licensing rather than outright loss, TPU9i content of more than $750 per TPU). The hawkish Fed keeps me from going above $89.
supervisor_summary: The five round-2 forecasts have converged: median about $86, fair values $85.5-90, thesis breaks $58-60. They share the same facts: strong AI datacom orders, about 26x 2027 EPS, and a sharp 2028 capex slowdown. My fact-checks confirmed that Kyber was reported delayed to 2028 (Nvidia disputes it) and that APH is licensing its backplane IP and leading the TPU9i design, which makes the GF Foxconn report look like dilution in 2028 rather than a loss in 2027. They also confirmed a hawkish Fed (Kalshi: 70% chance of a December hike) that most agents ignore. These offset, so I keep the mean ladder (P>=86 = 0.516) with low confidence. Fair value is $89 and the thesis break $59. Expect a roughly flat, fat-tailed year that swings on the Oct 28 print and 2027 capex budgets.
key_drivers: AI datacom momentum: 43% of sales and +63% organic in Q2-26 on a 1.23 book-to-bill. The Q3 guide is $9.3-9.4B and $0.70-0.71 post-split EPS (8-K). Sept channel checks (Edgewater) show connector book-to-bill of 1.2-1.3x and about 50-week fiber lead times.

2028 hyperscaler capex growth slows sharply (Goldman +12%, Morgan Stanley +14%, UBS +6%), and the stock will be priced on 2028 EPS by Oct 2027. That supports roughly 12-13% EPS growth and a 24-24.5x multiple, which puts fair value near spot.

Nvidia rack content: GF says FIT may be the major Kyber midplane supplier. SemiAnalysis says Kyber slipped to 2028 (Nvidia disputes this). Edgewater says APH licenses the VR Ultra backplane IP and leads TPU9i cabled-backplane design. The likely outcome is dilution in 2028, not a loss in 2027.
Rates: Kalshi prices a 70% chance of a December hike and 40% in January, a headwind for a 26x forward multiple that most agents ignore.
Event asymmetry: the Jan-26 beat sold off 12%, and the stock fell 20% in three weeks after Q1. 1-year realized vol is about 46%, so the fat tails are real.
